title: incident-bot: oncall diagnostics summary + runbook quicklinks for SLO alerts
author: Priya Menon
description: Add a compact on-call diagnostics summary and runbook quicklinks to SLO alert payloads so first-touch engineers get immediate context and remediation pointers. Motivation: reduce mean time to insight for SLO-triggered incidents by surfacing the most relevant runbooks, recent error-rate snippets, and suggested next steps directly in the alerting channel. What this PR implements: 1) runbook_quicklinks resolver: resolves best-matching runbooks from runbook registry using SLO tags and recent incident history; 2) compact summary builder: creates a condensed diagnostics card (top 3 signals, recent deploys, top errors) for Slack/Teams messages and API payloads; 3) notification adapters: include quicklinks and summary card in Slack block builder and Teams cards; 4) telemetry: emit tags for runbook_suggestions and summary_rendered for downstream metrics and alert auditing; 5) tests and e2e harness updates. Backwards compatibility: existing alert schema preserved; new fields are optional. Checklist: - [x] resolver implementation and unit tests - [x] summary builder + integration tests - [x] Slack/Teams adapters updated - [x] e2e test in staging passed - [x] docs/README updated with how quicklinks are selected and override semantics Links: Linear ENG-4121, Support ticket SUP-87. Testing notes: ran local unit tests, ran integration suite against staging incident-bot instance, exercised Slack messages using staging workspace; verified telemetry emitted and dashboards updated. Merge strategy: squash and merge after approvals.
